info.name: Rillet Accounting API Key Credit Memos API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor to navigate through the full response.

params.name: subsidiary_id
params.description: Subsidiary to be used when filtering data

params.name: updated.gt
params.description: Filter credit memos updated after this timestamp

items.docs:
Returns customer credit memos with pagination and filters for application state, customer, and subsidiaries.
Use credit memo ids with retrieve-a-credit-memo before updates or when applying credits to invoices.

Opens a customer credit memo that reduces receivable exposure before you allocate it to specific invoices.
Capture subsidiary, customer, line-level reasons, and tax treatment so finance can audit why the balance changed.

params.name: credit_memo_id
params.description: UUID of the credit memo to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Loads the full credit memo payload, including remaining balance, applications, and tax metadata you must echo on PUT updates.
Always retrieve before editing because update-a-credit-memo replaces the entire resource when fields are omitted.

params.name: credit_memo_id
params.description: UUID of the credit memo to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
IMPORTANT: This is a full-replace operation (PUT semantics). All fields must be
included in the request body — omitting any field will set it to null, wiping
existing data. Always call retrieve-a-credit-memo first to fetch the current record,
then include ALL existing fields in your update request along with your changes.

params.name: credit_memo_id
params.description: UUID of the credit memo to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Removes a credit memo that should no longer affect AR balances, typically while it is still draft or unused.
Confirm no invoice applications or downstream revenue adjustments depend on this memo before calling delete.

params.name: credit_memo_id
params.description: UUID of the credit memo to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Refreshes tax quotes on an existing credit memo using the same structured payload as invoice tax updates, stamped with taxesCalculatedAt for auditability.
Use after line items change or when your tax engine recomputes jurisdiction-specific amounts before issuing the credit to the customer.

params.name: credit_memo_id
params.description: UUID of the credit memo to be used in this operation.

items.docs: Full reconcile of credit memo applications. The request body represents the desired set: missing applications are removed, new applications inserted, and existing applications updated when amount or application_date differ.
